Caveat on source counter: ImportKey claims 1159 shipments / 19 partners / 33 ports, but only 5 rows were actually visible in the free view — the counter is a platform aggregate, not a verified row count. Domestic supply evidence (GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tenders, contracts, annual-report splits) could NOT be verified: web_search backend was unavailable (searx connection refused) and registry/aggregator pages (thecompanycheck, volza) returned 403. Therefore domestic_status = unknown, not 'none_found' — absence of evidence here is a tooling limitation, not proof of no domestic supply. No revenue or export-volume figures are public in the sources read, so those remain null. Role appears to be trader/exporter of dairy equipment rather than manufacturer (multiple third-party suppliers named as consignors, e.g. MILKOTESTER LTD, TARIMAK, SIREM INNOVATION DRIVER).
